red_lines.hack_exploit: May-Jul 2020 asset-reissue bug let attackers mint 301.8M RVN (~1.5% of cap), sold to exchanges; fixed at block 1,304,352 on 4 Jul 2020; coins never burned
red_lines.mint_path_live: no beyond the fixed PoW schedule: 1,250 RVN a block since 15 Jan 2026, 21B cap
red_lines.team_wallet_to_exchange_during_pump: not applicable: fair launch 3 Jan 2018, no premine, ICO or team allocation

front_matter_extras.revenue_mechanism: Asset-creation fees are burned automatically on-chain, but the amount is negligible and transaction fees go to miners; Revenue stays 1.
